svg.title: Squaring a standard-normal draw folds both signs onto a nonnegative axis
svg.desc: Two schematic density shapes. Left: a symmetric standard-normal bell with horizontal z axis in SD units, centered at zero. Right: the density of its square, only on nonnegative y, with a long right tail and an unbounded height as y approaches zero. Signed example values minus two and plus two both map to four; minus one half and plus one half both map to one quarter. Curves are schematic, not coordinate tables. All axes are dimensionless; density is per axis unit.
svg.text: Schematic shapes. Squaring changes the law; it does not merely relabel a linear axis.
